attempted_claim: Let E subset R^2 be analytic with d := dimH(E) >= s0 = 9/10, with no packing-dimension or Ahlfors-regularity hypothesis. Then sup_{x in E} dimH(Delta_x(E)) >= 7/10, where Delta_x(E) = {|x-y| : y in E}, proved via a Guth-Katz partitioning of degree D0=4 combined with an l^2-decoupling Mattila-energy gain and the Orponen-Shmerkin-Wang discretized radial-projection input transferred through an effective admissible partition. At d=9/10 this exceeds Fiedler-Stull Cor.3 (~0.651), Keleti-Shmerkin 2s/3 (=0.6), Shmerkin-Wang low-dim (~0.547), and Du-Ou-Ren-Zhang 5/3d-1 (=0.5).
